versions.subject: new susp service installation rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
  EventID: 7045
suspicious1:
  ImagePath|contains:
    - ' -w hidden '
    - ' -nop '
    - ' -sta '
    - '\Users\Public\'
    - '\Windows\Temp\'
    - '\Perflogs\'
    - '\\\\.\\pipe'
    - '\ADMIN$\'
    - '.downloadstring('  # PowerShell download command
    - '.downloadfile('  # PowerShell download command
suspicious2:
  ImagePath|contains|all: ' -e'
  ImagePath|contains:
    - ' JAB'  # PowerShell encoded commands
    - ' SUVYI'  # PowerShell encoded commands
    - ' SQBFAFgA'  # PowerShell encoded commands
    - ' aWV4I'  # PowerShell encoded commands
    - ' IAB'  # PowerShell encoded commands
    - ' PAA'  # PowerShell encoded commands
    - ' aQBlAHgA'  # PowerShell encoded commands
condition: selection and 1 of suspicious*
versions.spl: Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID=7045 ImagePath IN ("* -w hidden *", "* -nop *", "* -sta *", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*\\Perflogs\\*", "*\\\\.\\pipe*", "*\\ADMIN$\\*", "*.downloadstring(*", "*.downloadfile(*") OR (ImagePath="* -e*" ImagePath IN ("* JAB*", "* SUVYI*", "* SQBFAFgA*", "* aWV4I*", "* IAB*", "* PAA*", "* aQBlAHgA*"))
